title: Answer: no account of space, which enters as content the brain computes

statements.text: The global workspace theory takes no position on what space is. Space enters only as content the brain computes and may bring into the workspace: the spatial location of a sound can be attended to consciously, while the cues the nervous system uses to compute it, such as the small delay between the two ears, stay out of consciousness.
statements.scope: a theory of conscious access in the brain. Physical space lies outside it

sources.quote: We can consciously attend to the spatial location of a sound, but we are oblivious to the cues that our nervous system uses to compute it.
